info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Operational Services Channel Activity History By Channel Activity History Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Update Channel Activity History API allows for the modification of existing banking operational services channel activity records by their unique identifiers. This endpoint facilitates the adjustment of key details, ensuring that all channel activities reflect the most current information. Typically used by financial institutions, this API streamlines the management of operational records to enhance reporting accuracy and operational efficiency. Developers can utilize this API to keep channel activity histories up to date with minimal disruption to services.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific channel activity history entry identified by the resource ID RES-100045. It is essential for keeping track of changes in channel activities and recording updates in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the activity history for the specified operational channel. It includes details about the changes to be made, following the schema defined for the PATCH operation. Ensure that the required fields in the schema are populated correctly to execute the update successfully.
